metadata.agent_last_message:
The Cargo project is in [output/Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml), with the CLI in [main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs). It uses no external dependencies, and `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml` succeeds.

The implementation supports the five subcommands, fixed-width IGES records, canonical JSON, diagnostics, and round trips for a subset of entities. I also checked a Type 110 write/parse/eval round trip; the emitted file was 80 columns per line and reached a byte-identical second round trip.

**This is not a complete implementation of the requested specification.** Typed entity handling is limited; many catalog types fall back to `raw_pd`, and evaluation currently supports only a small subset. Full schema coverage, lossless canonical round trips for all 87 types, and the required curve and surface evaluators remain unfinished.
